lines.trans: Yes, I am Jonas, and I am responsible for security here.
Of course I notice who goes in and out here.
I am a big fan of the film where he plays the teacher.
I liked the film very much.
Hello! Do you have a token? I forgot my token.
Yes, I always have one on me for emergencies. Here you go!
Excuse me, could I perhaps take a photo with you?
Yeah, come on, make it quick, please.
Thank you! That's me and Elyas!
